response.sql: WITH type_avg AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS b FROM Products WHERE unit_price IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.avg_price FROM type_avg t, baseline b WHERE b.b IS NOT NULL AND t.avg_price > b.b), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS m FROM kept), final AS (SELECT k.production_type_code, k.avg_price FROM kept k, kept_mean km WHERE k.avg_price > km.m) SELECT AVG(f.avg_price) AS avg_type_average_price, AVG(f.avg_price - b.b) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(f.avg_price - km.m) AS avg_above_kept_mean FROM final f, baseline b, kept_mean km
